name: Ravnica
description: Ravnica is a plane with a worldwide cityscape of grand halls, slums and ancient ruins, where ten guilds vie for power under the Guildpact.

description_citations.text: "Ravnica". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.
"Ravnica". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

summary.text: Ravnica is a plane with a worldwide cityscape of grand halls, slums and ancient ruins, where ten guilds vie for power under the Guildpact.

citations.text: "Ravnica". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.
"Ravnica". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

bio.text: Ravnica is the home plane of Jace and Vraska, and the plane where their paths first crossed, with Vraska once trying to kill Jace there.

citations.text: "The Flood" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Jan 2018.
"Vraska". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

bio.text: Azor built its guild system and then left, and Jace later admitted he had not upheld his duties as Guildpact.

citations.work: The Arbiter of Law Left Chaos in His Wake
citations.text: "The Arbiter of Law Left Chaos in His Wake" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Jan 2018.

bio.text: Jace saw that Ravnica was Bolas's goal, and Vraska realized Bolas wanted her help to unleash an army on it.

citations.text: "Sabotage" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Jan 2018.
"Sabotage" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Jan 2018.

bio.text: Nicol Bolas then invaded the plane with the Dreadhorde.

citations.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Old Friends and New
citations.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Old Friends and New" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 May 2019.

bio.text: Its profile says that as the Guildpact dissolves through a mysterious outside threat, Ravnica descends into a cold war between the guilds.

citations.text: "Ravnica". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

bio.text: In the Murders at Karlov Manor story Proft deduced, and Niv-Mizzet confirmed, that Niv-Mizzet plans to make Ravnica the hub of the connected Multiverse.

citations.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 11: Portents and Omens
citations.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 11: Portents and Omens" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Feb 2024.

status.text: The material does not give a final fate for Ravnica; its latest events show it as a guild-ruled plane in a cold war between the guilds, with Niv-Mizzet planning to make it the hub of the connected Multiverse.

citations.text: "Ravnica". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

citations.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 11: Portents and Omens
citations.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 11: Portents and Omens" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Feb 2024.

timeline.summary: Dravin deserts after seeing a blazing archon and weeping at the idiocy of war.
timeline.quote: I dropped my sword and wept at the idiocy of war.

citation.text: Blazing Archon (Ravnica: City of Guilds, 2005), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Orzhov start using hawks as messengers to bypass toll roads, creating a profitable business.
timeline.quote: The Orzhov started using hawks as messengers in order to bypass the many toll roads and bridges that dot Ravnica.

citation.text: Courier Hawk (Ravnica: City of Guilds, 2005), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Kitov leaves a checkpoint in the hound Ditri's care.
timeline.quote: Ditri, I leave this checkpoint in your capable teeth.

citation.text: Gate Hound (Ravnica: City of Guilds, 2005), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The Festival of the Guildpact pauses violence for one day a year.
timeline.quote: for at least one day a year arms are laid down in favor of brimming goblets.

citation.text: Festival of the Guildpact (Ravnica: City of Guilds, 2005), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Niszka calls for pruning Ravnica into verdant uniformity.
timeline.quote: Ravnica, like a hedge, must be pruned, leaving only leaves of verdant uniformity.

citation.text: Hour of Reckoning (Ravnica: City of Guilds, 2005), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Tharashk the Bold is erased from identity by a Mark of Eviction.
timeline.quote: Tharashk the Bold suddenly wasn't himself.

citation.text: Mark of Eviction (Ravnica: City of Guilds, 2005), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Szadek expresses mixed feelings about sphinxes.
timeline.quote: Their wisdom I crave, but their secrecy I can't tolerate.

citation.text: Cerulean Sphinx (Ravnica: City of Guilds, 2005), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Agrus Kos describes finding a victim drained to a sack of skin and robes.
timeline.quote: As it turned out, it *was* the victim, insides sucked out—just a sack of skin and robes.

citation.text: Disembowel (Ravnica: City of Guilds, 2005), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Czaric argues for outliving mortal law through undeath.
timeline.quote: Why limit yourself to mortal law when you can outlive those who enforce it?

citation.text: Strands of Undeath (Ravnica: City of Guilds, 2005), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Trivaz mocks the Selesnya and Aszala voices a taste for angel's flesh.
timeline.quote: My favorite meal is angel's flesh, slain in agony and iced with black vinegar.

citation.text: Ribbons of Night (Ravnica: City of Guilds, 2005), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Pajik is amazed by his new powers while his cat Rivin is less enthused.
timeline.quote: Pajik was amazed and pleased at his newfound powers.

citation.text: Sparkmage Apprentice (Ravnica: City of Guilds, 2005), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Savra directs the planting of Golgari dead in a dark sanctuary.
timeline.quote: Plant our brethren here. This shall be our sanctuary.

citation.text: Dark Heart of the Wood (Ravnica: City of Guilds, 2005), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Svania Trul's last words doubt a map.
timeline.quote: This map has got to be wrong

citation.text: Perilous Forays (Ravnica: City of Guilds, 2005), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Yuri takes up the ragged Boros banner and inspires his brethren back into the fight.
timeline.quote: Yuri took up the ragged Boros banner, and his brethren, inspired by the act, followed him back into the fight.

citation.text: Rally the Righteous (Ravnica: City of Guilds, 2005), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Otiev watches his hand deliver the sign of death in his own courtroom.
timeline.quote: But in his courtroom he was only a spectator, watching his hand deliver the sign of death.

citation.text: Twisted Justice (Ravnica: City of Guilds, 2005), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Brev Grezar admires a flame item as lantern and lance.
timeline.quote: Now *that's* military efficiency.

citation.text: Flame Fusillade (Ravnica: City of Guilds, 2005), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The loxodon hierarch is willing to die to bring back the Ravnica of his memory.
timeline.quote: If my death serves to bring back the Ravnica in my memory, then so be it.

citation.text: Loxodon Hierarch (Ravnica: City of Guilds, 2005), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Ilromov describes fate being bent to spare his life.
timeline.quote: That was until some force bent fate's bars to spare my life.

citation.text: Ghost Warden (Guildpact, 2006), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Klattic describes a blade passing harmlessly through his hollow ghostly form.
timeline.quote: I watched its blade swing through me, but I was hollow, empty.

citation.text: Ghostway (Guildpact, 2006), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Rakdos cultists hang a rusalka, whose ghost keeps vigil at the Tree of Weeping.
timeline.quote: Rakdos cultists hanged her for sport in the township square.

citation.text: Martyred Rusalka (Guildpact, 2006), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The watch captain recounts a spell-borne call to arms giving the watch the advantage.
timeline.quote: The call came, and the advantage was ours.

citation.text: To Arms! (Guildpact, 2006), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Szadek says none can oppose one who cannot be found.
timeline.quote: None can oppose one who cannot be found.

citation.text: Infiltrator's Magemark (Guildpact, 2006), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Agosto warns that a deed cannot be undone but the doer can.
timeline.quote: Your deed cannot be undone. You, however, can be.

citation.text: Repeal (Guildpact, 2006), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Zok's chant is interrupted by frazzling.
timeline.quote: The chant was interrupted, the components cooked, and Zok worried that it was his brain he smelled smoking.

citation.text: Frazzle (Guildpact, 2006), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Voka Schlak writes of fearing to keep an open mind.
timeline.quote: I fear to keep an open mind

citation.text: Abyssal Nocturnus (Guildpact, 2006), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Ilromov warns that guild fealty will bring the old gods back.
timeline.quote: The old gods shall resurface.

citation.text: Sanguine Praetor (Guildpact, 2006), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Agrus Kos advises that the first blow is most important.
timeline.quote: The first blow is the most important.

citation.text: Fencer's Magemark (Guildpact, 2006), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Ghut Rak plans to bring the guilds down to earth.
timeline.quote: It's time we brought them back down to earth.

citation.text: Crash Landing (Guildpact, 2006), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Bougrat tells plants stories of revenge against mortals.
timeline.quote: stories of how they once ruled the world, of the mortals who destroyed their kind, and of revenge.

citation.text: Earth Surge (Guildpact, 2006), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Razia senses duty to an empty void in angels of despair.
timeline.quote: It is as if their duty is to an empty void.

citation.text: Angel of Despair (Guildpact, 2006), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Teysa mocks the Gruul for following Borborygmos.
timeline.quote: the only orders he gives are 'Crush them!' and 'We eat!'

citation.text: Borborygmos (Guildpact, 2006), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Vuliev claims the Ghost Council's sigil is stamped on the heavens on hallowed days.
timeline.quote: Who truly runs this city?

citation.text: Culling Sun (Guildpact, 2006), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Nephilim awaken, one after another, shaking the plane.
timeline.quote: When it awoke, it shook the plane with the thunder of its craving.

citation.text: Glint-Eye Nephilim (Guildpact, 2006), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Borborygmos orders his horde to crush.
timeline.quote: Crush them!

citation.text: Wreak Havoc (Guildpact, 2006), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Myznar reports an experiment run through a lab-goblin's brain as a success.
timeline.quote: My burners' flames fell asleep while the beakers jumped about and shattered.

citation.text: Schismotivate (Guildpact, 2006), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Otak shouts that the sky is being thrown at them.
timeline.quote: The sky isn't falling—it's being thrown at us!

citation.text: Skarrgan Skybreaker (Guildpact, 2006), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Augustin IV speaks of peace gentle yet unstoppable.
timeline.quote: As peace should be—gentle yet unstoppable.

citation.text: Azorius Herald (Dissension, 2006), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Augustin IV promises quiet in his presence.
timeline.quote: This world may not know peace, but in my presence you *will* know quiet.

citation.text: Swift Silence (Dissension, 2006), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Alovnek demands justice now rather than waiting for the arbiters.
timeline.quote: But I will have justice *now*!

citation.text: Condemn (Dissension, 2006), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Guilds exterminate those who know too much; some vindictive ghosts turn their knowledge against the guilded.
timeline.quote: Guilds often exterminate those who saw or knew too much.

citation.text: Enemy of the Guildpact (Dissension, 2006), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Savra declares the dead move to necromancy's hollow rhythm.
timeline.quote: All dead move to the hollow rhythm of necromancy.

citation.text: Macabre Waltz (Dissension, 2006), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Gorev Hadszak finds a victim bearing marks of an executed killer.
timeline.quote: but he was executed years ago!

citation.text: Unliving Psychopath (Dissension, 2006), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Rakdos relishes entertainment with his dinner.
timeline.quote: I like a little entertainment with my dinner.

citation.text: Cackling Flames (Dissension, 2006), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Rakdos calls on his servants to rage, renewing ancient power in blood.
timeline.quote: Rage, my servants. Our ancient power is renewed in blood.

citation.text: Psychotic Fury (Dissension, 2006), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Svar warns of incoming flame-kin.
timeline.quote: We have incoming!

citation.text: Flame-Kin War Scout (Dissension, 2006), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Ghut Rak finds a good use for an Azorius courthouse.
timeline.quote: Finally, a good use for an Azorius courthouse.

citation.text: Weight of Spires (Dissension, 2006), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Momir Vig proposes pitting Razia and the Azorius sky marshals in a bidding war to fund Project Kraj.
timeline.quote: We could create a fine bidding war—enough to fund the final stages of Project Kraj.

citation.text: Assault Zeppelid (Dissension, 2006), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Belko warns of the Demon's work in a rain of gore.
timeline.quote: This is the Demon's work, and only ill can come of it.

citation.text: Rain of Gore (Dissension, 2006), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Rakdos adds the touch of having spikes rip through the skin from beneath.
timeline.quote: Having the spikes rip through the skin from beneath was a touch added by Rakdos himself.

citation.text: Riot Spikes (Dissension, 2006), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Ukl is killed after wanting to take a bronze bombshell with them.
timeline.quote: Ooh, shiny! Let's pull off the chain and take her with us.

citation.text: Bronze Bombshell (Dissension, 2006), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Leaders of the ten guilds use go-betweens rather than meeting face to face.
timeline.quote: Reluctant to meet face to face, the leaders of the ten guilds prefer to do official business through a go-between immune to bribes and threats.

citation.text: Transguild Courier (Dissension, 2006), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Maree suggests tracking Jace's long disappearances and Ral is appointed Head Researcher of Project Lightning Bug.
timeline.quote: Thus Ral had been appointed Head Researcher of a project to record and explain Beleren's disappearances.

citation.text: "Project Lightning Bug" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 May 2015.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Gideon and Dars watch Foundry Street burn in a goblin gang war that began with Dargig's murder.
timeline.quote: It was the Shattergang way of declaring war.

citation.text: "Limits" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jul 2015.

timeline.summary: Gideon brings the captured Krenko, stabbed twice in the leg, to the Boros garrison.
timeline.quote: "And I come bearing gifts," said Gideon

citation.text: "Limits" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jul 2015.

timeline.summary: A canister lands in the garrison with a note from the Shattergang Brothers threatening Boros territory unless Krenko is handed over.
timeline.quote: Turn him over to us, or we will reduce Boros territory to rubble.

citation.text: "Limits" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jul 2015.

timeline.summary: Gideon storms the Shattergang hideout, fights Rikkig and survives his bomb; Rikkig escapes while Gideon and Dars free prisoners.
timeline.quote: "The Boros didn't take Krenko. I did. Just like I got your brother. And now I'm here for you."

citation.text: "Limits" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jul 2015.

timeline.summary: Jace is surprised to see Liliana knocking at his secret door via the teleportal, and uses an illusion to greet her.
timeline.quote: Jace hadn't seen Liliana Vess since the day he'd realized she was playing him

citation.text: "Catching Up" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Jul 2015.

timeline.summary: Liliana enters, and Jace refuses to trust her after she betrayed him; she reveals she had a spy killed to find him.
timeline.quote: "Nothing you can say will make me trust you," he said. "Not after you betrayed me."

citation.text: "Catching Up" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Jul 2015.

timeline.summary: Liliana explains she is killing her demonic creditors, with two down, and describes the Chain Veil and how Garruk is becoming a monster.
timeline.quote: "Two down," she said, holding up two fingers and grinning. "Two to go."

citation.text: "Catching Up" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Jul 2015.

timeline.summary: Liliana admits she hoped they could start over, and Jace plays along, agreeing to dinner.
timeline.quote: I guess I was hoping we could … start over.

citation.text: "Catching Up" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Jul 2015.

timeline.summary: Liliana storms out when Jace agrees to go with Gideon, refusing his invitation to come along.
timeline.quote: "You're out of your mind," she said. "I've got demons to kill."

citation.text: "Catching Up" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Jul 2015.

timeline.summary: Jace agrees to help Gideon, insisting he rest first, and takes him to a healer.
timeline.quote: "Fine," Gideon said at last. "Take me to this healer."

citation.text: "Catching Up" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Jul 2015.

timeline.summary: Gideon recruits Jace on Ravnica but not Liliana or Chandra, and the two return to Zendikar.
timeline.quote: Together, Gideon and Jace returned to Zendikar to face the threat of the Eldrazi.

citation.text: "Battle for Zendikar Story Summary" by Mel Li. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Dec 2015.

timeline.summary: Liliana finds Chandra hiding in an alley and persuades her to come along shopping.
timeline.quote: She was crouched halfway down an alley three blocks from Jace's home

citation.text: "Homesick" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Liliana invites Chandra to join her and talk on the way.
timeline.quote: Then I suppose you'll have to come along and see.

citation.text: "Homesick" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Nissa feels overwhelmed and alone among the crowds of Ravnica, cut off from Zendikar's voice.
timeline.quote: She'd never been among so many, and never been so alone.

citation.text: "Homesick" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Ral Zarek privately meets Jace at a Rakdos show to tell him about an irregular planeswalk.
timeline.quote: An irregular planeswalk.

citation.text: "In This Very Arena" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Oct 2016.

timeline.summary: Ral explains that Vraska left Ravnica for no destination, as if into a void, and has not been seen since.
timeline.quote: She didn't planeswalk to a plane. Only from one.

citation.text: "In This Very Arena" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Oct 2016.

timeline.summary: Ral reveals he can still detect when Jace leaves Ravnica, and chides him for leaving the Guildpact.
timeline.quote: First to Zendikar, then off to Innistrad, was it?

citation.text: "In This Very Arena" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Oct 2016.

timeline.summary: Ral warns Jace that others would love his position and to make more effort.
timeline.quote: Just remember there are those who'd love to be in the position you've blundered your way into.

citation.text: "In This Very Arena" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Oct 2016.

timeline.summary: Liliana appears and tells Jace that Tezzeret is alive and well on Kaladesh.
timeline.quote: Tezzeret. Alive and well.

citation.text: "In This Very Arena" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Oct 2016.

timeline.summary: Liliana demands that Jace come to Kaladesh and bring the muscle, then planeswalks away.
timeline.quote: Come to Kaladesh. Bring the muscle.

citation.text: "In This Very Arena" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Oct 2016.

timeline.summary: Jace abandons Ral and goes to fetch Gideon.
timeline.quote: dodged down an alleyway to fetch Gideon.

citation.text: "In This Very Arena" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Oct 2016.

timeline.summary: Liliana recalls working for Bolas and turning Jace against Tezzeret, and Jace wrecking Tezzeret's mind on Ravnica four years ago.
timeline.quote: Jace had wrecked Tezzeret's mind and left him for dead on some remote plane.

citation.text: "Puppets" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Jan 2017.

timeline.summary: In a memory, Mazirek and Vraska share tea and talk of leadership and pride.
timeline.quote: If I am to be met with disrespect, then I must first love myself with a fierceness no fool can take away.

citation.text: "Pride of the Kraul" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 May 2017.

timeline.summary: Mazirek recalls meeting Vraska while consulting the Ochran assassins, and their friendship since.
timeline.quote: Mazirek trusted Vraska with his life.

citation.text: "Pride of the Kraul" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 May 2017.

timeline.summary: In a memory, Mazirek rages that Jarad has cut the kraul's food and ignored them, and Vraska suggests change without bloodshed.
timeline.quote: There are plenty of ways to enact change without shedding blood.

citation.text: "Pride of the Kraul" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 May 2017.

timeline.summary: Vraska tells Jace about Ravnica, and he conjures an illusion of the snowy city, which she admires with homesickness.
timeline.quote: Yes. This is Ravnica.

citation.text: "Something Else Entirely" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Oct 2017.

timeline.summary: Vraska is struck by a vision of Ravnica from Jace's mind while swimming.
timeline.quote: Vraska was still in Ixalan, but the image in her mind was of Ravnica.

citation.text: "The Race, Part 2" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Oct 2017.

timeline.summary: Vraska sees a memory of a teenage Jace getting white tattoos from a Gruul shaman on Ravnica.
timeline.quote: The shaman leaned over the teenager and drew a line with his finger down Jace's cheek, leaving a brilliant white tattoo in its place.

citation.text: "The Flood" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Jace's memory shows Vraska as a menacing figure the first time they met.
timeline.quote: It was the first time they had met.

citation.text: "The Flood" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Vraska apologizes for trying to kill Jace on Ravnica.
timeline.quote: I'm sorry I tried to kill you on Ravnica,

citation.text: "The Flood" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Azor admits he left Ravnica when he finished and Jace admits he has not upheld his duties as Guildpact.
timeline.quote: Because Ravnica was one of many, and I left when I was finished.

citation.work: The Arbiter of Law Left Chaos in His Wake
citation.text: "The Arbiter of Law Left Chaos in His Wake" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Jace saw that Ravnica was Bolas's goal.
timeline.quote: Ravnica was writ large upon the ambition in Nicol Bolas's mind.

citation.text: "Sabotage" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Vraska realizes Bolas wants her help to unleash an army on Ravnica.
timeline.quote: He wants to unleash an army.

citation.text: "Sabotage" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Vraska returns to her chamber on Ravnica after the portal closes.
timeline.quote: she was standing back in her own chamber on Ravnica.

citation.text: "Wool Over the Eyes" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Feb 2018.

timeline.summary: Vraska finds Bolas's letter summoning her to the meditation plane.
timeline.quote: MEDITATION PLANE

citation.text: "Wool Over the Eyes" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Feb 2018.

timeline.summary: Vraska feels uneasy that she may be missing something.
timeline.quote: She felt unsettled, though she could not remember anything that might be missing . . . or why.

citation.text: "Wool Over the Eyes" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Feb 2018.

timeline.summary: Bolas's note names her guildleader and gives a location for Jarad.
timeline.quote: HE IS ALONE AND IMPRISONED HERE

citation.text: "Wool Over the Eyes" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Feb 2018.

timeline.summary: Vraska prepares to petrify Jarad.
timeline.quote: and contemplated what she ought to say to Jarad before she petrified him.

citation.text: "Wool Over the Eyes" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Feb 2018.

timeline.summary: Merret, working the docks as a Dimir agent, nearly pockets a bottle of expensive whiskey from a crate before his boss approaches and he hides it.
timeline.quote: Sloppy, Merret, sloppy.

citation.text: "Under the Cover of Fog" by Nicky Drayden. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Oct 2018.

timeline.summary: Grimbly Wothis orders Merret to clear the fog from the harbor for an investor, threatening to dock his pay.
timeline.quote: How's this for confidence . . . you don't clear it and you don't get your pay for today?

citation.text: "Under the Cover of Fog" by Nicky Drayden. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Oct 2018.

timeline.summary: Merret barely thins the fog and reveals a Simic schooner cloaking itself, which Wothis uses as a selling point to the investor.
timeline.quote: Fog swirls, barely, clearing about halfway to the other side of the river

citation.text: "Under the Cover of Fog" by Nicky Drayden. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Oct 2018.

timeline.summary: Failing to steal from a posh grocer, Merret breaks into Grimbly Wothis's apartment through an unlocked window.
timeline.quote: I round the building, make a quick hop to the balcony, and sure enough, find an unlocked window.

citation.text: "Under the Cover of Fog" by Nicky Drayden. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Oct 2018.

timeline.summary: Merret takes a loaf of bread and drinks drops of an Elixir of Focus from Wothis's kitchen.
timeline.quote: Just one more, for good measure.

citation.text: "Under the Cover of Fog" by Nicky Drayden. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Oct 2018.

timeline.summary: Wothis's wife enters the kitchen, and the elixir sharpens Merret's magic enough to make himself invisible to her.
timeline.quote: I draw on magic, and her mind opens up to me like a map.

citation.text: "Under the Cover of Fog" by Nicky Drayden. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Oct 2018.

timeline.summary: Empowered, Merret clears the whole harbor, then in a show-off moment casts a nightmare on the crane operator Yantis, dropping a crate of whiskey toward Wothis and the investor.
timeline.quote: Yantis screams, fighting all the terrifying nothings in front of him.

citation.text: "Under the Cover of Fog" by Nicky Drayden. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Oct 2018.

timeline.summary: Wothis shoves the investor into the river and jumps in as the crate smashes; Merret fears House Dimir will erase him.
timeline.quote: Nope, there's nothing covert about ruining a thousand zinos worth of cargo.

citation.text: "Under the Cover of Fog" by Nicky Drayden. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Oct 2018.

timeline.summary: Leighbet demands a promotion from Master Dax, is fired and loses her access and title, and starts an unsanctioned lab in the boilerpit beneath her apartment.
timeline.quote: that just leaves you standing at the front steps of the Lightning Rod, a box full of your desk belongings in your arms.

citation.text: "Testing the Dark Waters" by Nicky Drayden. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Oct 2018.

timeline.summary: Leighbet hires Tamsyn Sweene as a blastseeker, who claims past experience and passes a practical test.
timeline.quote: Tamsyn Sweene. Call me Tammy, and we've got a problem.

citation.text: "Testing the Dark Waters" by Nicky Drayden. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Oct 2018.

timeline.summary: Their serum, made from rift plant samples, makes a lab mouse completely impervious to electricity.
timeline.quote: It's completely impervious to electricity.

citation.text: "Testing the Dark Waters" by Nicky Drayden. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Oct 2018.

timeline.summary: Tamsyn tells a false story of her chemister's death and talks Leighbet into hiring her by promising to get the lab approved without sanctions.
timeline.quote: I can get your lab declared an Innovative Niche Workshop.

citation.text: "Testing the Dark Waters" by Nicky Drayden. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Oct 2018.

timeline.summary: Tamsyn gets the lab officially recognized by the Izmundi and recruits five paid test subjects, and the serum protects all of them from electric shocks.
timeline.quote: The other four tests go exactly the same, successes all around.

citation.text: "Testing the Dark Waters" by Nicky Drayden. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Oct 2018.

timeline.summary: Tamsyn convinces Leighbet that the test subjects must be silenced and poisons all five with a lethal sleep elixir, and Leighbet goes along with it.
timeline.quote: I already gave them all a hyper-concentrated dose of sleep elixir laced with an ethereal death accelerant.

citation.text: "Testing the Dark Waters" by Nicky Drayden. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Oct 2018.

timeline.summary: Desperate for money, Leighbet signs up for paid experiments and is transformed by Simic biomancers into a clawed, fanged monster, then flees into the sewers.
timeline.quote: my teeth are reshuffling, becoming jagged and ragged like a mouthful of fangs.

citation.text: "Testing the Dark Waters" by Nicky Drayden. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Oct 2018.

timeline.summary: Bozak, harvesting rare mushrooms on the family farmstead, hears the undercity news that a new lich seeks an apprentice skilled at mushroom identification.
timeline.quote: the lich is seeking an apprentice with a proficiency in mushroom identification and a keen interest in necromancy.

citation.text: "Death's Precious Moments" by Nicky Drayden. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Nov 2018.

timeline.summary: Bozak explains why he wants to be a necromancer and sneaks away from his siblings and Mother's carapace to enter the contest.
timeline.quote: I pack my maps, my journals, my vials, and my harvester's satchel and sneak away while my siblings lie dreaming.

citation.text: "Death's Precious Moments" by Nicky Drayden. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Nov 2018.

timeline.summary: The lich starts a contest for twenty-six competitors to retrieve four of the most dangerous mushrooms in Ravnica, handing out maps.
timeline.quote: Only one of you will be deemed skillful enough to serve as my apprentice,

citation.text: "Death's Precious Moments" by Nicky Drayden. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Nov 2018.

timeline.summary: Zegodonis bumps Bozak and tears his map; Bozak then spots woodwraiths in the mangrove and warns a few others, who escape while the rest are killed.
timeline.quote: We hear the creaking of old branches and the suck of roots pulling up from waterlogged soil.

citation.text: "Death's Precious Moments" by Nicky Drayden. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Nov 2018.

timeline.summary: Bozak meets the kraul Limin and the gorgon Kata, collects zombie fungus, and makes a temporary truce with Limin.
timeline.quote: If we share information and resources, we can all but guarantee a kraul will win.

citation.text: "Death's Precious Moments" by Nicky Drayden. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Nov 2018.

timeline.summary: An elf competitor punctures his zombie fungus, is overtaken by spores and climbs a tree to die as a host.
timeline.quote: The elf chooses a tree and scales it like his body had been built for this sole purpose.

citation.text: "Death's Precious Moments" by Nicky Drayden. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Nov 2018.

timeline.summary: Bozak collects devouring angel mushrooms from a mossdog den while Limin spreads his scent; Limin throws a rock and wakes the dogs and flies off.
timeline.quote: tossing a rock into the mossdog den

citation.text: "Death's Precious Moments" by Nicky Drayden. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Nov 2018.

timeline.summary: Bozak and Kata team up against the mossdogs; Kata petrifies them but also kills nearly a hundred of Bozak's locusts.
timeline.quote: The third mossdog turns into a statue, and with it, nearly a hundred locusts.

citation.text: "Death's Precious Moments" by Nicky Drayden. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Nov 2018.

timeline.summary: Kata tries to petrify Bozak, and he stabs her in the stomach with his staff carved from Mother's leg.
timeline.quote: I move fast, thrust the staff forward. It catches the gorgon in the stomach.

citation.text: "Death's Precious Moments" by Nicky Drayden. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Nov 2018.

timeline.summary: Riding a deadbridge goliath, Bozak races back while the surviving Zegodonis ambushes Limin and steals his satchel; Bozak reaches the lich first.
timeline.quote: He batters Limin as he passes, breaking off two legs and part of a wing.

citation.text: "Death's Precious Moments" by Nicky Drayden. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Nov 2018.

timeline.summary: The lich declares both Bozak and Zegodonis his apprentices, though he favors Zegodonis.
timeline.quote: And both of you shall serve under me.

citation.text: "Death's Precious Moments" by Nicky Drayden. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Nov 2018.

timeline.summary: Months later Bozak tends zombies and learns that Boros officers have been exposed to zombie fungus, and Vraska fears Boros will use it to infiltrate the undercity.
timeline.quote: Three high-ranking Boros officers were exposed to the same type of zombie fungus we had been asked to gather.

citation.text: "Death's Precious Moments" by Nicky Drayden. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Nov 2018.

timeline.summary: Alone in the lich's sanctum, Bozak tries a death spell for the first time on a rat corpse.
timeline.quote: I practice the movements I've seen the lich do

citation.text: "Death's Precious Moments" by Nicky Drayden. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Nov 2018.

timeline.summary: Hiding in a nook, Bozak overhears the lich telling Boros soldiers that he planted a devouring angel mushroom on Vraska's gown to frame her for the Tin Street massacre.
timeline.quote: Boros will have no choice but to charge Vraska with murder.

citation.text: "Death's Precious Moments" by Nicky Drayden. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Nov 2018.

timeline.summary: The lich reveals he hopes Boros will back a Devkarin successor as guildmaster, and the soldiers hint Zegodonis is their pick.
timeline.quote: they take into consideration the help I've been to you today.

citation.text: "Death's Precious Moments" by Nicky Drayden. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Nov 2018.

timeline.summary: Bozak reanimates the rat for the first time and uses it to bite the lich, creating a distraction so he can flee to warn Vraska.
timeline.quote: then takes a chomp on the lich's ankle.

citation.text: "Death's Precious Moments" by Nicky Drayden. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Nov 2018.

timeline.summary: Bozak survives the fall but wakes controlled by the fungus, with Mazirek tending him, and willingly submits to serve him.
timeline.quote: ready and willing to serve him as best I can

citation.text: "Death's Precious Moments" by Nicky Drayden. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Nov 2018.

timeline.summary: Ambrellin tells Terrik to forgive himself, and he hides a wurm under his bed while telling her the neighbors' wurm sightings are over-meditation.
timeline.quote: do you really think I'd be able to fit a half-grown wurm under my bed?

citation.text: "Bound and Bonded" by Nicky Drayden. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Nov 2018.

timeline.summary: Terrik uses bramble seeds to stop an Orzhov thug trying to sell him insurance, then reaches the orphanage near the ruined basilica.
timeline.quote: thorny vines erupt from the sidewalk, entangling my pursuer in their scratchy embrace.

citation.text: "Bound and Bonded" by Nicky Drayden. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Nov 2018.

timeline.summary: Bazda steals Terrik's shears and follows him home to the Selesnyan cooperative.
timeline.quote: It's only fair I hold something valuable of yours.

citation.text: "Bound and Bonded" by Nicky Drayden. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Nov 2018.

timeline.summary: Ambrellin identifies Bazda's artifact as ancient Izzet technology and calls it priceless.
timeline.quote: I've seen them before on ancient Izzet machinery

citation.text: "Bound and Bonded" by Nicky Drayden. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Nov 2018.

timeline.summary: Savaryn announces his promotion and that he and Kellim will move away, upsetting Terrik.
timeline.quote: We're not commuting,

citation.text: "Bound and Bonded" by Nicky Drayden. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Nov 2018.

timeline.summary: Terrik proposes one last adventure and reveals his young wurm is his bed; the friends reluctantly agree to explore beneath the basilica.
timeline.quote: Not quite. The wurm is the bed.

citation.text: "Bound and Bonded" by Nicky Drayden. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Nov 2018.

timeline.summary: The group escapes on the wurm through molten rock with weaving healing spells, and Bazda is reunited with her parents.
timeline.quote: Mama? Papa?

citation.text: "Bound and Bonded" by Nicky Drayden. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Nov 2018.

timeline.summary: Terrik returns Bazda's artifact via Ambrellin and the friends find Terrik's wurm asleep in the neighbors' bed.
timeline.quote: Looks like she found her way back home, give or take a floor.

citation.text: "Bound and Bonded" by Nicky Drayden. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Nov 2018.

timeline.summary: On the way home Zita fixes graffiti insulting Dovin Baan, and an Azorius arrester arrests her for defacing a building and slandering a Grand Arbiter, with Kodolaag's statement logged against her.
timeline.quote: defacing a public building," he continues, "Plus Azorius code 6342-P, slandering a Grand Arbiter," the arrester says, binding Zita up

citation.text: "The Illusions of Child's Play" by Nicky Drayden. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Jan 2019.

timeline.summary: Kodolaag and Olrich visit the precognition mage Lucinka, who gives them a box and instructions for freeing Zita.
timeline.quote: Visit Udzec tomorrow morning. Get in line behind the minotaur with a curly red mane.

citation.text: "The Illusions of Child's Play" by Nicky Drayden. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Jan 2019.

timeline.summary: Lucinka tells Zita, Olrich and Kodolaag they can never return to their old lives and should form a troupe in the undercity to hunt dangerous escapees.
timeline.quote: You'll have to set up new lives in the undercity,

citation.text: "The Illusions of Child's Play" by Nicky Drayden. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Jan 2019.

timeline.summary: Medge shows her students a motionless elder monk, and Kaszira calculates how long he has meditated from the plankton on him.
timeline.quote: Seven weeks. That's how long the elder monk has been meditating.

citation.text: "The Principles of Unnatural Selection" by Nicky Drayden. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Feb 2019.

timeline.summary: Ptero Zallik shows off his crustacean mutation and tells Medge that Guardian Project reinforcements have cut the open protectorate spots to sixty-two.
timeline.quote: The Guardian Project has decided to send in some reinforcements. They're taking eighteen spots.

citation.text: "The Principles of Unnatural Selection" by Nicky Drayden. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Feb 2019.

timeline.summary: Medge takes her eight students beyond the safe waters to watch a krasis in action, where they witness a krasis kill a resplendent benthid.
timeline.quote: A stinger erupts from the tip of the krasis's tail and strikes a killing blow on the beast's soft underbelly.

citation.text: "The Principles of Unnatural Selection" by Nicky Drayden. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Feb 2019.

timeline.summary: A voice rasping 'passage' draws Medge, Kaszira and Miko into a wreck, where they find a ghost.
timeline.quote: The human locks eyes with Miko.

citation.text: "The Principles of Unnatural Selection" by Nicky Drayden. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Feb 2019.

timeline.summary: The ghost Andrik introduces himself as a sailor who fell through a zonot and asks to be taken home with his crew's bodies.
timeline.quote: I am seaman Andrik, most unfortunate sole survivor of the Heckless

citation.text: "The Principles of Unnatural Selection" by Nicky Drayden. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Feb 2019.

timeline.summary: Medge agrees to help the ghost reach the surface, and the students lighten and refloat the ship with a benthid vocal sac for buoyancy.
timeline.quote: We spend nearly an hour and a half of constant blowing, but the ship starts to shift in the ocean bed.

citation.text: "The Principles of Unnatural Selection" by Nicky Drayden. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Feb 2019.

timeline.summary: At the showing, every student except Miko and Kaszira is placed in the protectorate, and Kaszira appears as a Simic biomancer student.
timeline.quote: I see her in the audience . . . dressed in Simic biomancer robes.

citation.text: "The Principles of Unnatural Selection" by Nicky Drayden. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Feb 2019.

timeline.summary: Medge and Ptero reconcile and agree to tend their clutches together next year.
timeline.quote: Maybe next year we can team up,

citation.text: "The Principles of Unnatural Selection" by Nicky Drayden. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Feb 2019.

timeline.summary: Miri's first refusal as a tithe taker: a citizen refuses the thirty-percent tithe, curses the Obzedat and attacks her, and she subdues him.
timeline.quote: I dealt him a forearm to the temple and then used my staff to sweep his feet from underneath him.

citation.text: "The Ledger of Hidden Fortunes" by Nicky Drayden. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Feb 2019.

timeline.summary: Miri gives her father the money she skimmed from tithes, and it is revealed the family fortune was lost with the Ghost Council.
timeline.quote: He'd returned home with the truth: there was no family fortune.

citation.text: "The Ledger of Hidden Fortunes" by Nicky Drayden. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Feb 2019.

timeline.summary: Miri reveals she secretly works for a fleshmage making thrulls and gives half her pay to help citizens short on tithes.
timeline.quote: So I got a second job assisting a fleshmage.

citation.text: "The Ledger of Hidden Fortunes" by Nicky Drayden. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Feb 2019.

timeline.summary: Miri's father comes home with a thrull-replaced leg after a failed scheme involving an Izzet machine and wurms, and curses Selesnya.
timeline.quote: Father cursed the Selesnya Conclave

citation.text: "The Ledger of Hidden Fortunes" by Nicky Drayden. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Feb 2019.

timeline.summary: Miri overhears a woman begging Jarek for her life with information on a Vitu-Ghazi vulnerability, and Jarek flays her and binds her spirit to a tome.
timeline.quote: He flayed the borrower from head to toe

citation.text: "The Ledger of Hidden Fortunes" by Nicky Drayden. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Feb 2019.

timeline.summary: Miri steals the dead spy's Selesnyan robes.
timeline.quote: I shoved the robes into my satchel.

citation.text: "The Ledger of Hidden Fortunes" by Nicky Drayden. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Feb 2019.

timeline.summary: Miri's father catches her in the Selesnyan robes, and she lies that she is going undercover to exploit the vulnerability at Vitu-Ghazi.
timeline.quote: I'm going undercover to see if I can find it

citation.text: "The Ledger of Hidden Fortunes" by Nicky Drayden. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Feb 2019.

timeline.summary: Miri's mother secretly gives her the Crown of Convergence to give her father in place of the vulnerability, and Miri gives it to him.
timeline.quote: The Crown of Convergence? Miri, this is worth thousands!

citation.text: "The Ledger of Hidden Fortunes" by Nicky Drayden. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Feb 2019.

timeline.summary: Miri returns to work after the tithing revolt ends at eighteen percent and presents her father with a secret enchanted money tree.
timeline.quote: It's an enchanted money tree,

citation.text: "The Ledger of Hidden Fortunes" by Nicky Drayden. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Feb 2019.

timeline.summary: Reza flies a griffin over Ravnica, passing his own law rune in the sky, and then is thrown when lightning shoots a thopter.
timeline.quote: I try to compensate so I can steady it, but my efforts make things worse, and I lose my grip.

citation.text: "The Ascension of Reza" by Nicky Drayden. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Feb 2019.

timeline.summary: Rat, stunned by news of Hekara's death, stabs an Eternal about to kill Teyo, and Kaya takes Rat and Teyo with her.
timeline.quote: Furious, I leapt at it and stabbed it in the eyes.

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica – The Path to Opulent
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica – The Path to Opulent" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 May 2019.

timeline.summary: Gideon Jura tells the planeswalkers to split up through the city to save people and rally others, and Kaya recruits Rat and Teyo.
timeline.quote: We need to split up. Spread out through the city.

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica – The Path to Opulent
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica – The Path to Opulent" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 May 2019.

timeline.summary: Kaya leads Rat and Teyo across Ravnica toward Orzhova, saving people and telling them to shelter indoors, since Eternals do not enter buildings.
timeline.quote: The saving grace was that, for whatever reason, the Eternals weren't entering any of the buildings.

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica – The Path to Opulent
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica – The Path to Opulent" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 May 2019.

timeline.summary: Teyo, Kaya and Rat discuss the Gatewatch and Teyo admits he has killed only a spider.
timeline.quote: Never heard of 'Gatewatch' before today.

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica – The Path to Opulent
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica – The Path to Opulent" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 May 2019.

timeline.summary: Kaya's shortcut leads to a dead end, and Rat reveals the alley is a dead end as Eternals enter it.
timeline.quote: Another crop of Eternals had entered the mouth of the alley.

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica – The Path to Opulent
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica – The Path to Opulent" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 May 2019.

timeline.summary: Gruul warriors led by Domri Rade charge the Eternals from behind and save the trio.
timeline.quote: attacked the Eternals from behind, axes chopping through lazotep.

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica – The Path to Opulent
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica – The Path to Opulent" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 May 2019.

timeline.summary: Teyo and Kaya save Gan Shokta from a dying Eternal, and Rat reveals Gan is her father.
timeline.quote: That's Gan Shokta. My father.

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica – The Path to Opulent
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica – The Path to Opulent" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 May 2019.

timeline.summary: The Gruul, Izzet and Simic forces fight together, and the group meets planeswalkers Kiora and Samut, who frees dead Eternals by name.
timeline.quote: You are free, Eknet.

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica – The Path to Opulent
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica – The Path to Opulent" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 May 2019.

timeline.summary: Gruul, Simic and Izzet storm a hill together, and Huatli, Saheeli Rai and Kasmina join; Bombop and a Simic shaman are killed.
timeline.quote: Poor Bombop rushed in too far ahead of the rest of us.

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica – The Path to Opulent
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica – The Path to Opulent" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 May 2019.

timeline.summary: Gan Shokta refuses to follow Domri and goes back to Borborygmos, and Domri leads others to the plaza.
timeline.quote: I'm going back to Borborygmos.

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica – The Path to Opulent
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica – The Path to Opulent" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 May 2019.

timeline.summary: A viashino planeswalker is killed by an Eternal that drains his life force, and the fire shoots toward Bolas.
timeline.quote: Then that fire rocketed into the air, shooting like a comet toward Tenth District Plaza and the dragon.

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica – The Path to Opulent
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica – The Path to Opulent" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 May 2019.

timeline.summary: Jace mind-calls everyone to retreat and meet at the Azorius Senate.
timeline.quote: Meet us at the Azorius Senate. Now.

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica – The Path to Opulent
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica – The Path to Opulent" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 May 2019.

timeline.summary: Zarek and Beleren task Kaya with bringing the Golgari, Rakdos, Gruul and Selesnya to the table for Operation Desperation, and Rat offers to help.
timeline.quote: But Master Zarek and Mister Beleren tasked Mistress Kaya with bringing the other four wayward guilds

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Desperate Operatives
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Desperate Operatives" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 May 2019.

timeline.summary: Rat leads Kaya, Teyo and Nissa through secret routes past the Eternals on the way to Selesnya.
timeline.quote: I know most of the secret routes through Ravnica

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Desperate Operatives
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Desperate Operatives" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 May 2019.

timeline.summary: Teyo shields the group while Nissa asks an old birch tree to kill a crop of Eternals.
timeline.quote: Teyo put up a shield, and from behind it, Miss Revane asked permission of an old birch tree

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Desperate Operatives
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Desperate Operatives" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 May 2019.

timeline.summary: Ral succeeds in shutting down the Beacon, which Kaya and Teyo sense.
timeline.quote: Ral must have succeeded in shutting down the Beacon.

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Desperate Operatives
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Desperate Operatives" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 May 2019.

timeline.summary: Rat urges Kaya to give Vraska the benefit of the doubt, and Kaya and Zarek accept Vraska's offer to help.
timeline.quote: Then Mistress Kaya sighed heavily and turned to Queen Vraska to accept her help.

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Desperate Operatives
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Desperate Operatives" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 May 2019.

timeline.summary: Ajani Goldmane, pinned down in an old chapel by Eternals, calls up through the grate and reports that Khazi was harvested.
timeline.quote: Khazi was harvested when an Eternal punched its hand right through the wall and grabbed her by the wrist.

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Desperate Operatives
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Desperate Operatives" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 May 2019.

timeline.summary: Ajani and Vraska introduce themselves; Vraska promises the Golgari will keep the civilians safe.
timeline.quote: Welcome to Golgari territory, Ajani Goldmane. You are safe here.

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Desperate Operatives
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Desperate Operatives" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 May 2019.

timeline.summary: Ravnican children and planeswalkers Mu Yanling, Jiang Yanggu and Huatli are lowered to safety through the grate.
timeline.quote: Miss Mu Yanling and Mister Jiang Yanggu

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Desperate Operatives
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Desperate Operatives" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 May 2019.

timeline.summary: Vraska turns three pursuing Eternals to stone, sealing the hole behind the last evacuees.
timeline.quote: Queen Vraska locked eyes with each of them in turn, transforming all three to stone.

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Desperate Operatives
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Desperate Operatives" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 May 2019.

timeline.summary: Vraska reports that the Golgari are opening pathways to safety across the city, winning back a little of Zarek's trust.
timeline.quote: We are fighting Bolas's army and preserving life.

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Desperate Operatives
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Desperate Operatives" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 May 2019.

timeline.summary: With the Golgari tunnels to Rix Maadi closed, the group surfaces and sees that the portal is gone from Tenth District Plaza, so the Planar Bridge has been shut down.
timeline.quote: Now, it was clear that Mister Fayden, Mister Karn, Miss Samut, and the Demon-Man Ob Nixilis had successfully shut down the Planar Bridge, as well.

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Operation Desperation
